subject: example: WP-2 storage-integrity repair
scope: store.py schema 5 migration, claims.support_of, adversarial rowid tests

findings.title: Example: migration must drop all triggers before table rebuild
findings.summary: Cross-table trigger bodies reference the table being renamed; without dropping triggers first, RENAME fails and the transaction rolls back.
evidence: sqlite3.OperationalError: error in trigger tombstones_forget: no such table: main.records (reviewer prototype, 2026-10-22)
findings.reproduction: Create a v4 vault, run the rebuild without dropping triggers: OperationalError.

builder_response.note: Migration drops every trigger first and recreates all of them; test asserts trigger count equality.
